mining_bot.description: Autonomously mines designated mineral deposits and transports them to storage. The colony grows even while you sleep. Slower than a laser miner but tireless.

farming_bot.description: Automatically waters, fertilizes, and harvests fields. Fully manages the farming module without human intervention. Multiple fields require multiple bots.

exploration_drone.description: Maps terrain from the air, detects mineral deposits. Faster than an exploration vehicle but cannot carry cargo. Its range is doubled with a radar tower.

robot_charging_station.description: Bots and drones automatically recharge when they return from a mission. Without this station, all autonomous systems are disabled.

medical_pod.description: Treats serious conditions such as broken bones, internal bleeding, and radiation poisoning. Saves lives in every scenario where a medkit falls short.

atmosphere_converter.description: Converts CO₂ into O₂ through a catalytic reaction. Supports the oxygen generator, creating a closed-loop atmosphere system. The foundation of long-term colony survival.

water_recycling_unit.description: Recycles wastewater and makes it drinkable. Ensures the colony's survival when access to a water source is cut off.

space_suit.description: Combines pressure, temperature, radiation, and oxygen protection in a single system. Mandatory for long-duration operations in the outside environment. An upgraded version of the radiation suit.

farming_cell.description: A fully controlled enclosed farming module. Light, water, and fertilizer systems are integrated. Produces three times the yield of a standard field.

energy_cell.description: An energy center that manages production, storage, and distribution in a single module. Stores excess energy during overproduction, distributes automatically during shortages.

processing_factory.description: Automatically converts raw minerals into processed parts. Greatly reduces the need for manual production. A powerful energy source is required to feed the entire system.

radar_tower.description: Increases the exploration drone's range and map resolution. Detects approaching dangers and hidden mineral deposits early.

cargo_platform.description: An automation platform for large mineral and material transfers. Manages transport between storage and production stations without the need for bots.
